messages:
olivia: Quick check-in for the interleaved bridge canary (ff/bridge_v2) — rolled to 3% traffic in us-east-1 at 08:00. Observability looks ok but saw a small p99 spike after the 08:10 deploy. anyone seeing anything else?

mike: I pulled traces, p99 spike correlates with a backend timeout to redis-cache-2 for ~45s. Error rate at ~0.4% on the slice, baseline was ~0.05%. digging into infra side.

james: Noted. I can temporarily reduce the canary to 1% if we want to limit blast radius. cc @olivia @tara

olivia: Hold on reducing for 5–10m, mike and noah investigate. If we see error rate >1% or sustained p99 > 1s, we roll back. Runbook link: https://handbook.redwood.com/runbooks/canary-rollback

sre-bot: [alert] Canary slice us-east-1: redis-cache-2 elevated latencies (avg 220ms -> 850ms) — created incident INC-2026-174. Automated fallback to pool B initiated.

noah: I ran `kubectl logs -n bridge canary-bridge-7f8d` — saw repeated `GET /cache 504` in a couple pods starting 08:09. Also noticed retries fired in client lib (x-retries=3). Pushing a patch to reduce retries for canary traffic: PR #3482.

tara: PR review incoming. Suggest we flip feature flag to `bridge_v2:partial=false` if spike persists >10m. Otherwise we can let the autoswitch to pool B handle it.

mike: Infra heatmap shows high cpu on redis-cache-2 host (i-0a12) coincident with full GC on JVM-based helper. Ops is restarting the JVM process now, will monitor.

olivia: Good, tracker: keep canary at 3% for now. mike/noah update back in 10. If rollback needed, I will cut a quick revert and notify product.

james: small FYI — sampling for user-affinity was enabled in this run; could inflate p99 due to extra routing. I'll toggle sampling off in a minute and push a config change.

noah: ops reports JVM restart completed, redis latencies trending down to normal. p99 returning to ~180ms, error rate falling. I also merged PR #3482 to reduce retries for canary route.

olivia: Thanks. Can we prepare a phased bump plan if stable? proposal: 3% -> 10% after 20 minutes stable, then 25% after 1h. Agree/disagree?

mike: agree on phased plan. I'll add a short smoke step after bump to verify tail latencies < 400ms and errors < 0.2%.

tara: noted. I'll schedule the FF gates in LaunchDarkly and set timers. Will post updates. :thumbsup:

olivia: OK, standing down for now. final note: document what we saw in the rollout notes (olivia/canary-1934567890) and add short action items: 1) follow up root cause for redis helper GC, 2) consider retry tuning for canary routes.

mike: added action items to the incident and pinged infra.

sre-bot: [resolve] INC-2026-174 resolved at 08:28 — latencies normalized, automation verified fallback worked as expected.

olivia: Great work team — we'll reconvene if the next bump shows anything.
